pay_detail: Cost is not stated on the page read.
name: IMSA AI Credential (online course)
what_you_do: Take a self-paced online course on how AI works, from machine learning to robotics, and on its ethics and safety. Weekly office hours with IMSA computer science faculty. You earn a certificate.
who_can_apply: Students in grades 9 to 12. No prerequisite courses.
deadline_text: This cohort runs September 28 to December 18, 2026, so it has already started. Not known: the page does not say if registration is still open or what it costs. Email studentenrichment@imsa.edu to ask.
how_to_apply: Use the sign-up link on the IMSA High School Online Programs page. To ask about cost and openings, email studentenrichment@imsa.edu.
notes: Asynchronous course with weekly office hours. The page said another cohort was added because of demand.
city: Online, run by IMSA in Aurora, IL
